name: signalwatch-editorial-extraction-holdout
limitations: Small, manually labeled English snippets; no claim of representative production precision or confidence calibration.
Frozen separately from extraction rules. Revisions must increment the version; do not tune rules against this corpus alone.
Scores require exact product and evidence-class agreement; extraction version, attribution, freshness and CVE applicability are evaluated elsewhere.
Ambiguous product words are included to expose taxonomy collisions; errors remain visible in the report.
